title-md.purpose: h3; headings in prose, footer and related row.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Only on things that float or lift: open menu, mobile menu panel, video thumbnail, related card on hover.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Arrow slides, menu fade-in, card lift, hero entrance.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Color and background fades on hover.

motion.name: hero-in
motion.purpose: Hero parts fade up once on load; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Sections fade up on scroll where supported; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 2.875rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .7rem 1.4rem; border: .125rem solid var(--brand); border-radius: 62rem; background: var(--brand); color: var(--white); font: 700 .9375rem/1.25 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s, border-color .2s, color .2s, transform .2s var(--ease); } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--brand-strong); border-color: var(--brand-strong); } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--brand); outline-offset: .1875rem; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Second action beside a solid button.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 2.875rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .7rem 1.4rem; border: .125rem solid var(--brand); border-radius: 62rem; background: transparent; color: var(--brand-strong); font: 700 .9375rem/1.25 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s, border-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--brand-strong); border-color: var(--brand-strong); color: var(--white); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: .1875rem solid var(--brand); outline-offset: .1875rem; }

components.name: Arrow link
components.description: Text link with an arrow for lesser actions.
components.html: Learn more
components.css: .ds-link-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .375rem; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--brand-strong); font: 700 1rem 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; } .ds-link-arrow svg { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; transition: transform .25s var(--ease); } .ds-link-arrow:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-link-arrow:hover svg { transform: translateX(.25rem); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A title with a short list or line.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: .625rem; padding: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--white); font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: var(--title-md); font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text); font-size: .9375rem; }

components.name: Quote
components.css: .ds-quote { display: grid; gap: 1.5rem; margin: 0; padding: var(--panel); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--tint); font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-quote blockquote { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-quote blockquote::before { content: '\201C'; display: block; height: 2.25rem; color: var(--brand); font-size: 4rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .ds-quote figcaption { display: grid; } .ds-quote strong { color: var(--ink); } .ds-quote span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8125rem; }

components.name: Step
components.description: One numbered step of a process.
components.css: .ds-step { position: relative; padding-top: 4rem; display: grid; gap: .5rem; font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-step::before { content: '01'; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brand); color: var(--white); font-weight: 800; } .ds-step h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: var(--title-md); } .ds-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .9375rem; }

components.name: Number
components.description: A big figure with a short label.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: grid; gap: .25rem; padding: .5rem 1.75rem; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-stat strong { color: var(--brand); font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 2.2vw, 3.25rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1; } .ds-stat span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Call band
components.description: The single most important call on a page, on red.
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem 2rem; padding: 2rem; background: var(--brand); color: var(--white); font-family: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-band h2 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.1rem + .8vw, 1.75rem); font-weight: 750; } .ds-band a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.875rem; padding: .7rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 62rem; background: var(--white); color: var(--brand-strong); font-weight: 700; font-size: .9375rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-band a:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); }

narrative.overview:
This is the website of IMFAHE, a US nonprofit that connects students and professors at partner universities with international mentors. Visitors are students, professors, mentors and partner organizations, reading in English, Spanish or Portuguese. This file is for the people and AI assistants who edit page content once or twice a year: it describes what the site already does so new content looks the same.

The site is plain HTML and one stylesheet, `docs/assets/site.css`. Pages are white, text is dark grey, and red is used for actions and small marks. Sections alternate white and light grey. Everything here was read from that stylesheet; if this file and the CSS disagree, the CSS is right.
keyCharacteristics: Noto Sans as the only typeface.
Photos keep their original colors. No filters, tints or overlays.
Icons come from Lucide. The four social logos (Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube) come from Simple Icons.
The organization's own wording. Do not rewrite, shorten or "improve" its text unless asked.

rules.name: The Red Is For Action Rule
rules.body: Large red areas are the button and the call band only. Red text for reading uses `--brand-strong`, not `--brand`.

dos: **Do** build pages only from the blocks in `content/COMPONENTS.md`, alternating white and `section--tint` sections.
**Do** use the color and size variables; let the layout rules place headings and text on wide screens.
**Do** keep one main action per section: one solid `button`, with `button--outline` or `link-arrow` for the rest.
**Do** mirror every English change in `content/es` and `content/pt`.
**Do** rebuild after editing (see README.md) and check the page on a phone-width window.
donts: **Don't** change the logo, the red, the typeface, or the organization's wording.
**Don't** add inline styles, new classes, new colors, new font sizes or a second typeface.
**Don't** put text inside pictures, or apply filters, tints or overlays to photos.
**Don't** use emoji or icons from outside Lucide and Simple Icons.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients or colored backgrounds to make a block stand out; use the red band once per page instead.
**Don't** add carousels, pop-ups, autoplay video or anything that moves by itself.
**Don't** write a header, footer, sub-menu or related-programs row inside a page; the build adds them.
**Don't** skip heading levels or add a second `h1`.
**Don't** embed YouTube directly; use the video block so nothing loads until clicked.
